title: MTG Commander Decklist Notation
description: Schema for MTG Commander Decklist Notation. Covers spec features through v1.2.0 (deck_rules.scenarios); the "version" field on documents validated by this schema is a semver string, not tied to this description.

version.description: Semantic version of the decklist format

commander.description: Cards that start in the command zone (commander, partner, background, companion)

main.description: Main deck cards (99 cards in Commander, or 98 when using a companion)

maybeboard.description: Considered but not included cards (excluded from deck_hash)

deck_rules.description: Strategic rules: mulligan scoring, combo declarations, anti-synergies

deck_id.description: Unique identifier for the deck (UUID recommended)

optical_deck_id.description: Unique 8-bit deck identifier (1..255) for optical computer vision and Data Matrix barcode proxy tracking

author.description: Name or username of the deck builder

description.description: Free-text description of the deck strategy

DecklistCard.description: A single card entry in the decklist

quantity.description: Number of copies of this card

name.description: Exact English card name as printed

edition.description: Set code identifying the specific printing (e.g., 'RNA', 'C16', 'MH2')

primary_mechanic.description: Main strategic role this card fills in the deck

additional_mechanics.description: Additional mechanic roles or synergy labels

slot_numbers.description: 1-indexed steady physical sleeve numbers (1..100 / 1..255) assigned to copies of this card across deck revisions

optical_ids.description: 6-character hex strings encoding 24-bit Data Matrix payloads (<DECK:2><CARD:2><PLAYER:1><FLAGS:1>) for each physical copy

note.description: Free-text note about this card's role or budget considerations

DeckRules.description: Strategic rules for evaluating and playing this specific deck

combos.description: Known synergistic combinations in the deck

dont_combos.description: Known anti-synergies and conflicting card pairs

scenarios.description: Strategic game states captured by the deck builder — opening hands, play sequences, board-state preconditions, or evaluation sequences (see spec §6.4)

MulliganRule.description: Mulligan scoring model: assign a value to each card and compare total to a threshold. As of v1.5.0, a consumer may instead (or additionally) implement the independent Mana Base Band model (mana_base_min/mana_base_max, spec §6.1.5) for the actual keep/mulligan decision — see those two fields' descriptions below.

mana_base_min.description: Mana Base Band lower bound (v1.5.0+, spec §6.1.5): below this total (lands + cheap mana-producing cards only, scored independently of card_values), the hand is not Playable. Additive — does not replace card_values/thresholds, which remain the only model the compact .dck AiHints= export (spec §6.1.4) understands.

mana_base_max.description: Mana Base Band upper bound (v1.5.0+, spec §6.1.5): a hand scoring above this is not a Good AI hand (too much mana) even though it may still be Playable. This stricter min<=score<=max check is mamo-sim's actual automated opening-hand-redraw criteria.

card_values.description: Standard per-mana-value curve used for hand scoring (v1.3.0+; previously 4 CMC-bucketed keys). See spec §6.1.1a for the X-cost adjustment and §6.1.1b for the multicolor land bonus applied on top of these base values.

land.description: Value assigned to any land card (default: 1.0). Multiplied by 1.0-1.4 for a land producing 2+ colors — see spec §6.1.1b.

mv0.description: Value for non-land cards with mana value exactly 0 (default: 0.85)

mv1.description: Value for non-land cards with mana value exactly 1 (default: 0.8)

mv2.description: Value for non-land cards with mana value exactly 2 (default: 0.75)

mv3.description: Value for non-land cards with mana value exactly 3 (default: 0.6)

mv4.description: Value for non-land cards with mana value exactly 4 (default: 0.2, capped v1.4.0+)

mv5.description: Value for non-land cards with mana value exactly 5 (default: 0.2, capped v1.4.0+)

mv6.description: Value for non-land cards with mana value exactly 6 (default: 0.2, capped v1.4.0+)

mv7Plus.description: Value for non-land cards with mana value 7 or higher (default: 0.2, capped v1.4.0+). {X}-cost cards count X=2 for this lookup — see spec §6.1.1a.

card_overrides.description: Per-card value overrides that take precedence over category defaults

thresholds.description: Minimum hand value per mulligan round to decide to keep

CardValueOverride.description: Override the default category value for a specific card

value.description: Custom mulligan value for this card

MulliganThreshold.description: Minimum hand score required to keep at a given mulligan round

round.description: Mulligan round (0 = initial 7-card hand; 1 = after first mulligan, etc.)

hand_size.description: Expected hand size at this round (informational)

min_value.description: Minimum total hand value required to keep

ComboDeclaration.description: A known synergistic combination of cards in the deck

id.description: Unique identifier for this combo within the deck

pieces.description: Card names required for the combo

result.description: Description of what the combo achieves

DontComboDeclaration.description: A known anti-synergy between cards in the deck

pieces.description: Card names involved in the conflict

reason.description: Explanation of why these cards conflict in this deck

severity.description: How badly the anti-synergy affects the deck (default: 'major')

CardRef.description: A card reference: either an exact card name, or a mechanic-group selector matching any card whose primary_mechanic/additional_mechanics includes the named group (see spec §6.4.1b)

ScenarioTurnEntry.description: Drawn and played cards for a single turn of a hand-based/eval_sequence scenario

turn.description: Turn number (1 = first turn of the game)

drawn.description: Card reference drawn at the start of this turn. Optional — a turn scripting only attack/activate actions against an existing permanent, with no new card drawn, can omit this.

played.description: Card references played this turn, in cast order

actions.description: Attack/activate actions against a permanent already in play this turn. Local extension (originating in MaMoFrontend's decklistExport.ts) — not yet part of every consumer's implementation of this spec.

source.description: The permanent already in play performing the action

ScenarioZoneRequirement.description: A required card/mechanic-group presence in a zone, used by precondition-based scenarios

mechanic_groups.description: Deck mechanic group keys satisfying this requirement

card_names.description: Specific card names required in this zone

min_count.description: Minimum matching cards required (default: count of listed items)

ScenarioPreconditions.description: Game-state conditions under which a mid_game/free_build scenario applies

description.description: Human-readable summary of required game state

turn_number.description: Turn number this scenario typically applies to

min_hand_size.description: Minimum number of cards in hand

ScenarioFocus.description: What a scenario demonstrates — specific cards, deck mechanic groups, or both

description.description: Free-text description of what the scenario demonstrates

ScenarioBoardState.description: An explicit (partial) zone snapshot for a scenario, complementing preconditions

turn.description: Turn number this board state applies to

zones.description: Map of zone name (hand/battlefield/graveyard/library/exile/commandZone) to card references

DecklistScenario.description: A strategic game state captured by the deck builder (see spec §6.4)

id.description: Unique identifier for this scenario within the deck

deck_id.description: Owning deck's identifier. Optional and normally implicit — a scenario embedded in a deck's own exported document belongs to that document's meta.deck_id. Only needed when a scenario reference crosses into another deck's context, e.g. attaching an opponent's own Perfect Game scenario to a constructed match (see forge-integration-guide.md §10, proposed — not yet a live pipeline).

mode.description: Execution mode: 'forced' sets a fixed library order; 'look_for' (default) monitors for a pattern match (see spec §6.4.1a)

opening_hand.description: Card references in the opening hand, in draw order (hand-based/eval_sequence types)

turns.description: Drawn and played cards per turn (hand-based/eval_sequence types)
